#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

struct Node {
    int diff;
    int indx;
    bool operator<(const Node& other) const {
        if (diff != other.diff)
            return diff < other.diff;
        return indx < other.indx;
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, k;
    std::cin >> n >> k;
    std::vector<int> arr(n);
    std::vector<int> oddEven(n, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> arr[i];
        if (i == 0) {
            if (arr[i] % 2 == 0)
                oddEven[i] = 1;
            else
                oddEven[i] = -1;
            continue;
        }
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 0)
            oddEven[i] = oddEven[i - 1] + 1;
        else
            oddEven[i] = oddEven[i - 1] - 1;
    }

    std::vector<Node> diffArr(n - 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        diffArr[i].diff = std::abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]);
        diffArr[i].indx = i;
    }

    int ans = 0;
    std::sort(diffArr.begin(), diffArr.end());

    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if (k >= diffArr[i].diff && oddEven[diffArr[i].indx] == 0) {
            if (k - diffArr[i].diff >= 0) {
                ++ans;
                k -= diffArr[i].diff;
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
